description: Enables Spreadsheet blocks in TmNotionEditor. When supplied, users can embed an interactive spreadsheet workbook in a page. Without this provider the Spreadsheet block type is hidden from the slash menu.

methods.name: GetSpreadsheetDocumentAsync
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet workbook by ID. Returns null if the document does not yet exist.

methods.name: SaveSpreadsheetDocumentAsync
methods.description: Persists a spreadsheet workbook and returns the saved version.

methods.name: CreateSpreadsheetDocumentAsync
methods.description: Creates a new empty spreadsheet workbook and returns its ID along with the workbook.
